name: marketplat-monorepo
description: MarketPlat web, API, and mobile applications in a shared monorepo

scripts.build:all: npm --prefix frontend run build && pnpm --recursive --if-present run build && pnpm --filter @marketplat/mobile build:bundle:ci && make -C apps/go-worker build
scripts.type-check:all: npm --prefix frontend run type-check && npm --prefix frontend run type-check:e2e && npm --prefix frontend run type-check:tests && npm --prefix frontend run type-check:scripts && pnpm --recursive --if-present run type-check && make -C apps/go-worker vet && pnpm run verify:type-suppressions
scripts.test:all: npm --prefix frontend run test && pnpm --filter classifieds-platform-backend test && pnpm --filter @marketplat/mobile test:all && pnpm --filter @marketplat/contracts test && pnpm --filter @marketplat/cf-api-proxy test && pnpm --filter marketplat-keepalive-worker test && make -C apps/go-worker test
scripts.lint:all: npm --prefix frontend run lint && pnpm --recursive --if-present run lint && make -C apps/go-worker fmt-check && pnpm run verify:type-suppressions
scripts.audit:http-requests: npm --prefix frontend run network:phase6-audit && pnpm --filter classifieds-platform-backend audit:http-payload-phase4 && pnpm --filter classifieds-platform-backend audit:db-query-phase5 && pnpm --filter classifieds-platform-backend audit:db-query-phase6
scripts.verify:all: pnpm run verify:workspace && pnpm run verify:prisma-layout && pnpm run lint:all && pnpm run type-check:all && pnpm run test:all && pnpm run build:all
